title: The lighthouse keeper's letter
hero_prompt: Painterly storybook illustration, elderly lighthouse keeper in yellow raincoat, stormy sea, warm lamplight, single character, 9:16 vertical frame, one scene
style_bible: Soft watercolor storybook, muted blues and amber lamp glow, gentle grain, consistent character face and coat

narration.style_prompt: Warm storyteller pace, ~2.2 words per second, clear diction, gentle emotion

music.prompt: Soft piano and strings, nostalgic bedtime story, no vocals, 72 BPM

scenes.edit_prompt: Wide shot: lighthouse tower against black clouds, keeper tiny at the railing, waves crashing
scenes.narration: On the night the letter arrived, the sea forgot how to be gentle.

scenes.edit_prompt: Close on wrinkled hands opening a sealed envelope, lamplight on the paper, same keeper coat
scenes.narration: The ink was faded, but the name was still legible — the one he had not spoken in thirty years.

scenes.edit_prompt: Interior lantern room, keeper reading by window, ghostly reflection of a younger face in the glass
scenes.narration: Some doors stay closed until the storm forces them open.

scenes.edit_prompt: Dawn breaking over calm water, keeper on steps with letter pressed to chest, golden light
scenes.narration: By morning, the letter was answered — not in words, but in the choice to walk back down the hill.
